Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_BraveKil: Earn Brave at this kill count, adjusted by penalties and benefits. Gaining it removes fear traits and keeps Adrenaline Junkie. Brave block prevents it with fear traits. Desensitized always prevents Brave. Set to -1 to disable Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Desensit: Earn Desensitized at this kill count, adjusted by penalties and benefits. Gaining it removes Brave, Adrenaline Junkie, and fear traits. Set to -1 to disable Desensitized.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_BraveBlo: Block Brave while the character has fear traits. Reluctant Fighter never blocks Brave. Kill penalties still apply when this is off.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Cowardly: Cowardly adds these kills to both traits' minimums and targets. Set to 0 to disable the penalty. Brave block controls whether Cowardly prevents Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Agorapho: Agoraphobic adds these kills to both traits' minimums and targets. Set to 0 to disable the penalty. Brave block controls whether Agoraphobic prevents Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Claustro: Claustrophobic adds these kills to both traits' minimums and targets. Set to 0 to disable the penalty. Brave block controls whether Claustrophobic prevents Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_FearOfBl: Fear of Blood adds these kills to both traits' minimums and targets. Set to 0 to disable the penalty. Brave block controls whether Fear of Blood prevents Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Reluctan: Reluctant Fighter adds these kills to both traits' minimums and targets. Set to 0 to disable the penalty. Reluctant Fighter stays after rewards and does not block Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_HunterKi: Hunter reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_BraveKil: Brave reduces the minimum and target for Desensitized. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_TargetSh: Target Shooter reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_DoctorKi: Doctor reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Lumberja: Lumberjack reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_NurseKil: Nurse reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_ParkRang: Park Ranger reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_PoliceOf: Police Officer reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Security: Security Guard reduces both traits' minimums and targets. Reductions add together. Set to 0 to disable this reduction.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_EarlyTra: Allow traits before their targets. Check kills each game minute and roll once per kill interval. Chance rises from 0% toward 10% near the target. The target guarantees the trait.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_BraveMin: Early chances for Brave start above this kill count, adjusted by penalties and benefits. Only applies with early traits enabled. Set to -1 or at least the target to disable early Brave.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Desensit: Early chances for Desensitized start above this kill count, adjusted by penalties and benefits. Only applies with early traits enabled. Set to -1 or at least the target to disable early Desensitized.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_KillsPer: New kills needed for each early roll. Every full interval adds a roll. Stop at the first success. Saves and reconnects preserve leftover kills.
Sandbox_BecomeBraveDesensitized_Debug_to: Writes tagged logs for reward and multiplayer events to help diagnose issues. Off by default.
